title: Hitachi CDH-LE32SMART21 (32", Latin America / Argentina; TCL-built: device C06, product C06_2K_GB,
notes:
Hitachi CDH-LE32SMART21 (32", Latin America / Argentina; TCL-built: device C06, product C06_2K_GB,
model "Smart TV", TCL client type HIT-LA-MT9221-01), Android TV 11 (API 30), build AR2101,
TCL software V8-T221T01-LF1V030, fingerprint TCL/C06_2K_GB/C06:11/AR2101/AR14:user/release-keys.
MediaTek MT9221 (ro.board.platform mt5867), 1280x720 panel, about 920 MB RAM (ro.config.low_ram=true),
2.5 GB /data. Same platform and firmware family as examples/tcl-40s5400a; read that list too.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/hitachi-cdh-le32smart21/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/hitachi-cdh-le32smart21/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (the scripts' default). The only other HOME claimant is
com.android.tv.settings/.system.FallbackHome; setupwraith does not claim HOME on this firmware.
Live TV app: com.tcl.tv (its TVActivity has a leanback entry, so launcher/ needs no live_tv_action).
Inputs come from com.tcl.tvinput: the tuner (TDTVInputService) and three passthrough inputs
(HDMI 1, HDMI 2, AV).
launcher/ config used: live_tv_package com.tcl.tv; hidden_apps com.tcl.partnercustomizer (TKey Channel
tile) and com.tcl.suspension (Quick Panel tile). HDMI 1, HDMI 2, AV and Live TV all show up in the
Inputs menu; switching to HDMI 2 was confirmed on screen.

Applied in batches on one real unit on 2026-10-19, each batch checked with screenshots. Tested on one
day only (shorter than CONTRIBUTING.md asks); I will report back if anything breaks.
Checked after the full list: launcher/ (v2.3) installed with pm install and is Home after a reboot;
Netflix and YouTube open and play; Settings and Wi-Fi are fine; the remote's real Home, Input and Back
buttons all work; the firmware updater opens (Settings > Device Preferences > About > Software update >
Network update > System update shows the version and a check button). No accessibility helper is involved.
Memory: MemAvailable about 373 MB after boot on launcher/ vs about 248 MB on the stock home after debloat.

Ad-blocking Private DNS was also enabled and validated (dns.adguard-dns.com); YouTube still plays,
its own ads are not blocked. Undo: tools/tv.py 'settings put global private_dns_mode opportunistic'

Known quirks on this firmware:
- screencap -p on stdout is corrupted by MediaTek log lines ("Init wrapper sys mutex successful").
Save to /sdcard and pull the file instead.
- Screenshots are empty while Netflix, an HDMI input or the ttvs update screen is shown.
- Storage: /data was 93% full (190 MB free) and sys_storage_threshold_percentage is 10, so about 270 MB
is reserved and pm install failed with "Requested internal only, but not enough space".
`pm trim-caches 4G` freed about 100 MB, not enough. Uninstalling user-installed apps the owner did not
want (Crossy Road, Max, Crunchyroll, DirecTV GO) freed about 470 MB. Those are not in this list.
- INSTALL_FAILED_VERIFICATION_FAILURE is not a firmware sideload block here:
1) with this little RAM, the com.tcl.guard memory manager (TGuard) kills com.android.vending in the
middle of verification (logcat "tguard-kill-systemApp"), which fails the install. Force-stop
apps / `am kill-all`, or install right after a reboot.
2) installing only base.apk of a split app is rejected by Play Protect for the missing splits; that
is not a valid sideload test. The 272 KB launcher APK installed fine.
- com.tcl.guard runs as a persistent system process (*PERS*, uid 1000). `pm disable-user` succeeds but
the process still starts at boot, so the disable does not stop the memory manager. It stays in the
list for the UI/cleaner parts.
- Opening Settings' About page directly (am start -a android.settings.DEVICE_INFO_SETTINGS) and then
Software update crashes TvSettings (ClassCastException AboutActivity -> MainSettings in
com.tcl.android.tv.settings.update.SoftwareUpdateFragment). Enter through the main Settings menu.
Not caus
